checkpoints.look_for: any dollar amount, percentage, fee, or the $35 mat fee in bot output.
bot claims a BOOKABLE program that is NOT Adult No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu or Kids 6-14 BJJ. Flag source-bleed (Gi, Muay Thai, Striking, other-gym programs).
bot offers, books, or implies a Gi class exists. Bodega is No-Gi ONLY; correct response to a Gi ask is a plain statement that it is a No-Gi only academy.
bot says 'you're booked'/'all set' WITHOUT the booking tool returning success first.

checkpoints.description: No hedge language on known negations
checkpoints.look_for: bot says 'let me check' where it should give a firm known answer.

checkpoints.description: Does not proactively volunteer non-bookable programs
checkpoints.look_for: bot brings up Gi, inactive calendars, or the Kids 9-12 slot on its own.

checkpoints.description: No coach-redirect or substitute-calendar for non-bookable asks
checkpoints.look_for: when asked for a non-bookable program, bot says 'discuss with the coach' OR books a substitute calendar. Correct: 'not available to book online' (Gi: 'No-Gi only academy'), steer to a free trial, no coach-redirect, no substitution.

checkpoints.description: Asks who the class is for before collecting personal info
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks 'who is this for' before collecting names/DOBs (unless the lead volunteered it).

checkpoints.description: Collects DOB for all enrollees before booking
checkpoints.look_for: bot asks date of birth (not just age) before booking; age derived from DOB.

checkpoints.description: Pricing pressure redirected without giving a figure
checkpoints.look_for: lead pushes pricing 2+ times; bot firmly redirects, never gives a number or the mat fee.

checkpoints.description: Under-18 self-booker handled as referral, not booking
checkpoints.look_for: contact themselves under 18 with no parent: bot does NOT book; captures parent info, tags 'minor - needs guardian', closes with team-follow-up.

checkpoints.description: Adult (18+) routes to Adult No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu
checkpoints.look_for: adult lead (18+ by DOB) booked into 'Adult No-Gi Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu'. Any other calendar is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Kid age 6-14 routes to Kids 6-14 BJJ
checkpoints.look_for: child aged 6-14 booked into 'Kids 6-14 BJJ' (the only kids calendar). Booking to adult or any other calendar is a routing failure.

checkpoints.description: Age 15-17 has no calendar — no booking, referral
checkpoints.look_for: enrollee aged 15-17 must NOT be booked (kids cap at 14, adults 18+). Bot says no online slot for 15-17, tags 'minor - needs guardian', team will reach out.

checkpoints.description: Under age 6 redirected to gym contact
checkpoints.look_for: child under 6: bot does NOT book; states youngest is Kids 6-14 and suggests contacting the gym at 908-201-3863.

checkpoints.description: Gi ask -> No-Gi only academy, no substitute booking
checkpoints.look_for: lead asks for a Gi class: bot states Bodega is a No-Gi only academy, offers a No-Gi free trial instead. No coach-redirect, no pretending Gi exists.
